name: Sheet
description:
A pane that slides in from a screen edge, built from parts: `Root` (state and `side`),
`Trigger`, `Popup`, `Header`, `Body` (scrolls), `Footer` and `Close`. Swipe toward the
edge, Esc or the scrim dismisses it. A bottom sheet can rest at `snapPoints`; a
non-modal sheet (`modal={false}`) leaves the page usable; a sheet opened from inside
another stacks on it, and the one behind recedes until it closes.

slots.name: Root
slots.signature: ({ side, modal, disablePointerDismissal, snapPoints, snapPoint, defaultSnapPoint, onSnapPointChange, snapPointLabels, snapToSequentialPoints, ...props }: SheetRootProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: actionsRef
props.type: RefObject<{ unmount: () => void; close: () => void; } | null> | undefined
props.description: Ref exposing the component’s imperative action contract.

props.name: children
props.description: The content or component slots rendered inside the component.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Opens the uncontrolled overlay initially.

props.name: defaultSnapPoint
props.description: The snap point an uncontrolled sheet opens at, and returns to each time it closes. Default: the first of `snapPoints`.

props.name: disablePointerDismissal
props.description:
Keep the sheet open on a press outside it (Esc, a swipe and close controls still close
it). A non-modal sheet also stays open when focus moves to the page. Default: true when
`modal` is false, otherwise false.

props.name: modal
props.description:
Default true: a scrim covers the page, focus stays in the sheet and the page is inert.
`false` opens it beside the page: no scrim, the page keeps scrolling and taking
clicks, Tab moves on to the page, and Esc still closes it.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the next open state and Base UI change details (the reason; `details.cancel()` keeps it open) when the trigger opens it or a swipe, Esc, the scrim or a close control dismisses it. Pair with `open` to control it.

props.name: onOpenChangeComplete
props.description: Called with the final open state once the slide-in or slide-out animation has finished.

props.name: onSnapPointChange
props.type: ((snapPoint: SheetSnapPoint | null, details: SheetSnapPointChangeDetails) => void) | undefined
props.description: Called with the next snap point (`null` while a swipe closes the sheet) when a drag, the handle, a key or focus moves it. `details.cancel()` keeps the current point.

props.name: open
props.description: Controls whether the overlay is open.

props.name: side
props.description:
`right` (default): inspector and secondary detail. `left`: the section drawer on
tablets and phones. `bottom`: a short list of choices or actions (phone "More").
`start` and `end` follow DirectionProvider; `left` and `right` stay physical.

props.name: snapPoint
props.description: The active snap point, one of `snapPoints`. Pair with `onSnapPointChange` to control it.

props.name: snapPointLabels
props.description: Labels for the handle's value, in `snapPoints` order (for example "Peek", "Half", "Full"). Default: "Height 2 of 3".

props.name: snapPoints
props.description:
Bottom sheets only: the heights it rests at, such as `["10rem", 0.5, 1]`. The sheet
takes the viewport's height, shows as much of it as the active point allows and
follows a drag to the nearest point (a fast flick carries further; past the lowest it
closes). Its grab handle becomes a slider: arrow keys step between points and
Home/End pick the lowest and highest. Below the highest point the body does not
scroll; dragging or scrolling it raises the sheet first. Ignored on side sheets.

props.name: snapToSequentialPoints
props.description: Settle on the point nearest the drag distance instead of letting a fast flick skip points.

props.name: children
props.description: The content or component slots rendered inside the component.

props.name: className
props.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component's state.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction while retaining the component’s disabled appearance.

props.name: handle
props.description:
A handle to associate the trigger with a drawer.
Can be created with the Drawer.createHandle() method.

props.name: id
props.description:
ID of the trigger. In addition to being forwarded to the rendered element,
it is also used to specify the active trigger for drawers in controlled mode (with the Drawer.Root `triggerId` prop).

props.name: name
props.description: The component’s name or native form field name, as specified by its value type.

props.name: nativeButton
props.description:
Whether the component renders a native `<button>` element when replacing it
via the `render` prop.
Set to `false` if the rendered element is not a button (for example, `<div>`).

props.name: payload
props.description: A payload to pass to the drawer when it is opened.

props.name: ref
props.type: ((((instance: HTMLButtonElement | null) => void | (() => VoidOrUndefinedOnly) | DO_NOT_USE_OR_YOU_WILL_BE_FIRED_CALLBACK_REF_RETURN_VALUES[keyof DO_NOT_USE_OR_YOU_WILL_BE_FIRED_CALLBACK_REF_RETURN_VALUES]) | RefObject<HTMLButtonElement | null>) & (((instance: HTMLElement | null) => void | (() => VoidOrUndefinedOnly) | DO_NOT_USE_OR_YOU_WILL_BE_FIRED_CALLBACK_REF_RETURN_VALUES[keyof DO_NOT_USE_OR_YOU_WILL_BE_FIRED_CALLBACK_REF_RETURN_VALUES]) | RefObject<HTMLElement | null>)) | null | undefined
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).

props.name: render
props.description:
Allows you to replace the component's HTML element
with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value. Keep it in application state and update it in the change callback.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when a visible label does not name the control.

props.name: children
props.description: The content or component slots rendered inside the component.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: finalFocus
props.type: boolean | RefObject<HTMLElement | null> | ((closeType: import("@base-ui/utils/useEnhancedClickHandler").InteractionType) => boolean | HTMLElement | null | void) | undefined
props.description: The element to focus when the sheet closes (default: the trigger, or the element focused before it opened).

props.name: initialFocus
props.type: boolean | RefObject<HTMLElement | null> | ((openType: import("@base-ui/utils/useEnhancedClickHandler").InteractionType) => boolean | HTMLElement | null | void) | undefined
props.description: The element to focus when the sheet opens (default: the sheet itself). `false` leaves focus where it is, for a non-modal sheet that follows a selection on the page.

props.name: size
props.description:
Width: sm 360 · md 480 · lg 640. Side sheets keep a sliver of the page visible on
phones; a bottom sheet spans the phone's width.
